name: Jash Dhamecha
headline: Building personal brands | Authority, Distribution and positioning for Founders & Entrepreneurs | Building Businesses & Life

sections.bio:
I build brands that don’t just look good they create attention, trust, and demand, positioning & growth marketing.

I've spent the last few years studying attention, positioning, buyer psychology and content to understand what makes people stop, trust, remember and eventually take action,
Because the internet doesn't always reward the most competent person.
It rewards the person whose expertise is easiest to understand, trust and remember
That's where I come in

I help founders, CTO's, CEO's, Professionals and operators build brands that turn expertise into:
/. Authority
/. Visibility
/. Trust
/. Inbound conversations
/. Qualified opportunities
/. Premium perception

I don't believe personal branding is about posting every day
And I don't believe you need another generic "10 tips" post
You need a positioning people can remember and a content system that reinforces it & I have acquired 5M+ views for my clients with this

The biggest lesson I've learned:
You don't need more attention
You need the right people paying attention for the right reasons
Because your online presence is already speaking for you

If you're a founder building a company and want your personal brand to become an asset to the business, 
DM me "BRAND."

I'll take a look at your positioning and tell you the biggest opportunity I see
